framing.decision: Does a pull request or commit series make a design decision the repository should record as an ADR?
framing.action: Refuse a structured merge that needs an ADR and has none
framing.baseline: agent/RULES.md instruction: decide in-scope questions and record the decision as an ADR; no check
framing.costs: Assumed equal: a miss leaves a decision unrecorded; a false action costs one unneeded ADR or prompt
framing.reviewers: innovation-council first pass, claude arbiter; owner may override
framing.state_fields: change: title, plan or description, commit headlines, diff summary; decision-record files and mentions removed

minimums.reason: assumed per jev-actions framing defaults: the owner gave none and costs are assumed equal

measured_band.note: measurement record only: without a fallback judge a band cannot decide
measured_band.rule: score <= 0.34: no ADR needed; score >= 0.67: ADR needed; between: escalate
measured_band.fallback: owner or the main agent reading the change; not measured
measured_band.accuracy_loss: not agreed; assumed none beyond the minimums
measured_band.derivation: yes_at_least: tune_threshold.py on scores.csv --min-precision 0.9 --min-recall 0.8 --repeats 5 (shipped 0.67, folds 0.615-0.705). no_at_most: 1 - shipped threshold of tune_threshold.py on scores with label and score inverted (P(no)) --min-precision 0.9 --min-recall 0.5 --repeats 5 (shipped 0.66, folds 0.33-0.68); at --min-recall 0.8 no threshold qualified
measured_band.cascade_note: cascade accuracy assumes the fallback answers every escalated case correctly; an upper bound until fallback verdicts are measured

label_set.unit: one pull request (oh-mi-pi-config) or one commit (game-system, raidar, scout); split 70/30 by sha256(unit) mod 100 < 30 = test
label_set.sources: replay only, read-only: oh-mi-pi-config merged PRs (sync PRs excluded), game-system, raidar and scout commits; no synthetic cases
label_set.adr_history: 38 cases added an ADR in the change (35 labelled 1, 3 labelled 0); 26 cases labelled 1 added none, such as decisions made before ADRs existed
label_set.provenance: agent_reviewed: innovation-council first pass blind to scores and ADR history (omp 19.0.1 headless, Opus 5.5 lead; peers as the runs reported them: GPT Astra, Gemini Neon, Opus experiment-peer, 7 runs of 17-19 cases); claude (Opus 5.5) arbitrated every case and overrode 4 (A017, A043, A054, A074), each with a note in labels.jsonl. 35 cases were relabelled by the council on the final state after a redaction fix; all 35 kept their label. 24 council labels are low confidence; 11 had a peer dissent
label_set.guide_note: The council labelled from guide sha256 daf3c3150b1fd34c23ba2ec03d368e39a735ab26b18b7d6a4355173f240f47f6; only rows N1 and T5 were shortened for the 100-column Markdown limit afterwards, with the same rules
label_set.redaction: 2026-11-21: device serials, a tailnet address, a node id, home paths and host names in case states and label notes were pseudonymised (owner/agent home, DEVICESERIALn, 100.64.0.10, nuc-host, nuc, mac-a)

results.scoring: one judge_batch over all 95 cases in the omp 19.0.1 eval kernel with an overlay setting modelRoles.judge to typesafe/jev-1.14.0 and no judge fallback; status reported model typesafe/jev-1.14.0, 95 done, 0 failed
results.tuning: tune_threshold.py --min-precision 0.8 --min-recall 0.8 --repeats 5: shipped 0.67; dev held-out P 0.91 R 0.92 F 0.91 (25 of 25 folds; fold thresholds 0.245-0.705); default 0.5 dev held-out P 0.88 R 0.93; test at 0.67 P 0.94 R 1.00, at 0.5 P 0.84 R 1.00. With --conservative --repeats 5 only 6 of 25 folds qualified (fewer than 50 dev cases per label), so the result is noisy
results.test_per_stratum: at 0.67: oh-mi-pi-config 13 cases P 0.91 R 1.00; game-system 4, raidar 3, scout 3 all P 1.00 R 1.00
results.dev_errors_at_threshold: A073 (FN 0.25), A030 (FP 0.70), A074 (FP 0.70), A031 (FP 0.72); A030, A031, A073 and A074 all had a council peer dissent, so the errors sit where labellers disagreed
results.rescore: A038 re-scored 2026-11-21 after pseudonymisation through the direct judge (model typesafe/jev-1.14.0): 0.22; band counts unchanged

calibration.keep: raw: Platt did not improve the held-out dev Brier score
calibration.display: probabilities stay internal: the label set is noisy and every bin holds only 24 cases

assumptions: Framing (action, costs, minimums, fallback) is assumed; the owner has not confirmed it
Labels are agent_reviewed, not human; the owner may override any label
The state removes decision-record files and mentions so labels and scores cannot read the outcome
shortfalls: test holds 7 negatives; grow negatives to about 30 per split at the next retune
framing and minimums are assumed; the owner has not confirmed them
A017's state omits the decision its commits make (missing state): pull request states hold the PR body and commit headlines, not commit bodies
band removed: no fallback judge; threshold is the former yes_at_least pending retune
wiring: lib/judged-rails.ts mergeReason, enforced from the start: a structured gh pr merge without an ADR file in the diff; yes refuses; a judge failure refuses the merge
